nodes.Name: mcentral
nodes.DocComment: Central list of free objects of a given size.

Fields.Name: partial
Fields.DocComment: list of spans with a free object

Fields.Name: full
Fields.DocComment: list of spans with no free objects

nodes.Name: init
nodes.DocComment: Initialize a single central free list.

nodes.Name: partialUnswept
nodes.DocComment:
partialUnswept returns the spanSet which holds partially-filled
unswept spans for this sweepgen.

nodes.Name: partialSwept
nodes.DocComment:
partialSwept returns the spanSet which holds partially-filled
swept spans for this sweepgen.

nodes.Name: fullUnswept
nodes.DocComment:
fullUnswept returns the spanSet which holds unswept spans without any
free slots for this sweepgen.

nodes.Name: fullSwept
nodes.DocComment:
fullSwept returns the spanSet which holds swept spans without any
free slots for this sweepgen.

nodes.Name: cacheSpan
nodes.DocComment: Allocate a span to use in an mcache.

nodes.Name: uncacheSpan
nodes.DocComment:
Return span from an mcache.

s must have a span class corresponding to this
mcentral and it must not be empty.

nodes.Name: grow
nodes.DocComment: grow allocates a new empty span from the heap and initializes it for c's size class.
